scope: PR91, same coordinator epoch overlapping prepare, artifact-bound activation only
schedule: Block A(v1,shaA) loader; coordinator.prepare B(v1,shaB) ACKs in same epoch; release A before activation; coordinator.activate B; inspect active SHA/reward/durable state.
primary_failure: Coordinator declares B activation successful while active SHA differs from B ACK SHA.
acceptable_fixed_outcome: Either B is active with its SHA/reward, or activation rejects without declaring success; explicit redeploy B must converge.
controls: same artifact overlapping prepares remain safe
limits: Deterministic localhost correctness; not field incidence, performance, model learning, or fleet-wide atomicity. Protocol written before this schedule is executed, after source inspection and earlier PR91 evidence.
